candidates.change_summary: Change `return _paused;` to `return true;` so the function always returns true regardless of state.
Change `return _paused;` to `return false;` so the function always returns false regardless of state.
Change `return _paused;` to `return !_paused;` so the function returns the inverse of the actual paused state.
Replace the non-zero address check with a require(false) so updateLRTConfig always reverts, preventing any update.
Delete the state update `lrtConfig = ILRTConfig(lrtConfigAddr)` so the config variable never changes.
Replace the state update with `lrtConfig = ILRTConfig(address(0))` so the config is always set to zero address.
Replace the state update with `lrtConfig = ILRTConfig(msg.sender)` so the config points to caller instead of the argument.
Delete the entire modifier body (onlyLRTAdmin) so it always passes, allowing anyone to call updateLRTConfig.
Change the role check to require false, making the modifier always revert, blocking all calls including updateLRTConfig.
Change the role check to use MANAGER instead of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so manager can update config.
Change the revert to a no-op, allowing execution even when role check fails.
